claims.text: The source identifies \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) as the ideal of \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) generated by \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\). [source-2@L1365-L1375|claim=formal-document]

In the integral box-Schur/Pieri presentation, for \(p=c=1\), \(q=i+1\), \(r=j+1\), \(d=ij\), and \(\min(i,j)=3\), \[ M_{d+4}=\bigoplus_{\substack{i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i+1)^{j+1}\\|\mu|=d+4}}\mathbb Zs_\mu, \qquad (A_+M)_{d+4}=\sum_{\ell=1}^{4}h_\ell M_{d+4-\ell}. \] The requested target is established, subject to that ambient integral presentation.
